items.title: Uniti raises $12M Series A to build the agentic AI layer for real estate operators
items.note: Pathlight-led round backs AI agents handling leasing, collections, maintenance and payments for ~100 property operators

items.title: MCP, AI's most important interoperability protocol, ships a major spec update
items.note: New version simplifies how developer agents connect to external tools and data, per startup Arcade's breakdown

items.title: Runway launches a model router to auto-pick the best AI model per generative-media request
items.note: Routes image/video/audio jobs across Runway's own and third-party models by cost, speed or quality; Adobe and Cloudflare are early API customers

items.title: Pending home sales fall to a 3-month low as mortgage rates hit an 11-month high
items.note: Weekly rate averaged 6.55% for the four weeks ending July 19, pushing buyers to the sidelines
